text:
Noah B: Quick sync - finalizing assets/copy for webinar 'Benchmarking Inference: Cost vs Latency' next Tue. Need X + LinkedIn variants, seedlist plan, and inbound tagging rules by EOD Mon.
Elena V: timeline works. recommend X primary post at 10:00 PT, LinkedIn at 13:00 PT. add a T+24h reminder for both.
Kai T: put draft copies in the doc: https://docs.google.com/benchmarks (tab: social). X short: "Benchmarking Inference: reduce cost without sacrificing latency. Live Tue. RSVP -> [link]"
Kai T: X alt (engineering): "How we dropped token cost 2.5x with caching + batching. Join our engineers Tue. Register: [link]"
Elena V: LinkedIn long: "Join Redwood engineers for a practical session on inference tradeoffs: benchmarking, quantization tips, and rollout patterns. Save your seat -> [link]"
Noah B: For benchmarking narrative, add one line in LP: 'we measured 5M tokens across 3 architectures' and include a short table screenshot. Helps PR/eng leads.
Kai T: good call. will add screenshot path: /assets/bench-table-v1.png and alt text.
martech-bot: Scheduling preview:
```
platform: x
publish_time: 2026-06-09T10:00:00-07:00
copy: "Benchmarking Inference: reduce cost without sacrificing latency. Live Tue. RSVP -> [link]"
image: bench-hero-v1.png
utm: utm_source=x&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_content=variant_primary
```
Elena V: Canary plan - seedlist of 4k developer-heavy users at T-48h. KPI: registration CTR >= 6% and form completions >= 1.5% to go wide.
SDR Ops: routing rules: if utm_campaign=benchmark_launch then tag=webinar_benchmark. If company_size>250 OR job_title contains (Found|Head|VP|Dir) -> tag priority_enterprise and route to enterprise-sdr. else -> sdr-rotation. Also add source_platform field.
Noah B: Add utm_content=variant_engineering/variant_general and utm_medium=social. We need to A/B headline on X for the first 2 hours: short vs technical. Auto-merge winner by CTR on register link.
Kai T: Image specs: LinkedIn 1200x628. X hero 1600x900. I'll export PNG + WebP, add two alt texts in sheet.
Elena V: Engagement follow-up plan: 1) immediate thank-you email with calendar link, 2) 24h post-email with bench highlights + CTA, 3) LinkedIn thread follow-up tagging speakers 4h after webinar.
SDR Ops: For high-intent signups (company_size>=500 or job_title includes "ML" and seniority>=Director), ping #sdr-priority and attach lead CSV row via webhook.
Noah B: Also compile a short benchmark narrative (3 bullets) for the social thread: 1) setup 2) key metric 3) action. Keep copy modular so we can swap into X/LinkedIn.
Elena V: I'll draft those bullets and paste into the sheet.
martech-bot: Canary scheduled: id=canary-556, audience=bench-dev-seed-4k, time=2026-06-07T10:00:00-07:00.
Kai T: final creative ETA Mon 9am PT. I'll upload to the assets tab.
Noah B: Perfect. Once assets + utm tested I'll queue the scheduler. Reminder: include tracking pixels and verify the LP event fires on submit.
Elena V: noted. will run form submit test and post results here.
SDR Ops: prepping the CSV mapping and webhook. Will share the mapping before EOD.
Noah B: Thanks team. small ask - add a one-line note in the post copy pointing to the benchmark blog for full methodology. helps credibility. :star:
